subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact `~`/`$OPENCLAW_HOME` path display by default, switch agent-visible paths to full home-expanded paths by default, or add an explicit display preference?
rationale: Current source and tests preserve compact display, while the requested behavior changes a user-facing default or adds configuration surface, which needs maintainer product intent.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Full Paths By Default
options.body: Change shared display helpers and agent prompt guidance so user-visible home paths render as full home-expanded paths.

options.title: Add Explicit Display Preference
options.body: Introduce a documented opt-in setting or environment variable for full home-expanded paths while keeping existing compact defaults.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME` as the default and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the central shortening helper and is the strongest history signal for the display-policy surface.
